newsitem.title: USA: Banyan Hotel fails to acquire toy maker.
newsitem.headline: Banyan Hotel fails to acquire toy maker.

text.p: Banyan Hotel Investment Fund said Monday that negotiations to buy a toy company had abruptly ended after the owner of the company decided against the idea.
"It came as a surprise to us," a spokesman for Banyan said. "We felt it (the deal) was closed."
He said the owner of the privately-held maker and distributor of toy, hobby and leisure products decided he did not want to go public.
The spokesman said he could not name the company, with which Banyan had been negotiating for about a year.
Talks ended on June 27, he added.
The spokesman said Banyan was pursuing other potential acquisitions in the real estate and electronics sectors.
